description: In Sevastopol, a man died as a result of the explosion of an IED planted in an urn near a house. Local newspapers write that before the explosion, a woman with a backpack was standing near the house and was tracking her victim. Katsap public whines that everything looks like "another sabotage by the Ukrainian special services according to the standard scenario." If so, congratulations on another successful liquidation and look forward to the details.
